best_section.where: the signed car park by the shed near the maintenance depot, about 80m down the hill from the dropped pin

drivers.seclusion: Bush and forest reserve on all sides; buildings nearby are a maintenance depot and sheds, not houses.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed winding road reaches a formed car park with marked bays big enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Sits on a lookout access road, so day visitor traffic is steady; likely quiet after dark but not guaranteed.
drivers.convention: Several cars already parked in the bay in the imagery, so a van wouldn't stand out.

flags: Steep approach: flattest nearby stretch still grades about 9.7%, close to the 12% rule-out line
Sits on a public lookout drive, so some night-time sightseer traffic is possible
Maintenance depot about 40m away may mean early-morning staff activity
reasons: Formed car park, cars already parked there
summary: Secluded bush car park near a depot, but reached only via a steep lookout road.
sun_shade: Shaded by surrounding tree canopy from most directions.
cannot_judge: Street lighting at the car park
Whether the depot gate is locked/monitored overnight
Actual night-time traffic volume on the lookout road
Crossfall within the car park bays
